name: Ocaperidone
summary: Ocaperidone (R 79598) is a benzisoxazole antipsychotic. It was initially developed by Janssen, later licensed to French laboratory Neuro3D and then acquired in 2007 by German company Evotec.

uses.text: It was initially developed by Janssen, later licensed to French laboratory Neuro3D and then acquired in 2007 by German company Evotec.

fact.en: It is a close relative of risperidone, which came from the same Janssen research programme in Belgium, but it was passed between three companies and never reached the market.
fact.zh: 它與理思必妥（risperidone）關係密切，同出自比利時楊森公司的研究計畫，但它在三家公司之間轉手，始終未能上市。
fact.zhHans: 它与理思必妥（risperidone）关系密切，同出自比利时杨森公司的研究计划，但它在三家公司之间转手，始终未能上市。
